Phase-contrast images of cell cultures were made using EVOS™ XL Core Cell Imaging System (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

If the percentage of cardiomyocytes in the population is insufficient, purification using the human PSC-Derived Cardiomyocyte Isolation Kit (Miltenyi Biotec, cat no. 130-110-188) can be performed. The isolation can be performed as a single step procedure with negative selection for CMs for up to 5 × 106 cells. To increase cell viability, it is recommended to perform the majority of procedures on ice. In short, a single cell suspension was made as described in 2.4 and centrifuged for 5 min at 200 g. The pellet was dissolved in 80 µl wash buffer (consisting of PBS supplemented with 2% FBS) and 20 µl Non-Cardiomyocyte Depletion Cocktail was added, mixed and incubated at 4 °C for 5 min. Next, the cells were washed with 1 ml wash buffer and centrifuged for 5 min at 200 g. The pellet was dissolved in 80 µl wash buffer. 20 µl Anti-Biotin MicroBeads were added, mixed and incubated for 10 min at 4 °C. 400 µl wash buffer was added to the cell suspension. An LS column was placed in the magnetic field of a MACS separator. The column was washed with 3 ml wash buffer. The cell suspension (500 µl) was added to the column and the flow-through was collected. The column was washed three times with 3 ml wash buffer, flow-through was collected in the same collection tube. The flow-through contains the purified CM cell suspension.

steps.title: Prepare coated culture plates
steps.instruction: Coat 6‑well and 12‑well CELLSTAR® plates (Greiner Bio One, cat no. 657160 and cat no. 665180) with Geltrex™ (Life Technologies, cat no. A1413302) according to the manufacturer’s instructions and allow the coating to set before use.

steps.title: Seed hESCs in Essential 8
steps.instruction: Culture human embryonic stem cell line H9 (WA09, WiCell) feeder‑free in Essential 8™ medium (Life Technologies, cat no. A1517001) supplemented with Penicillin/Streptomycin (100 U ml⁻¹ Penicillin and 100 µg ml⁻¹ Streptomycin, Life Technologies, cat no. 15140‑122) on the Geltrex‑coated plates; maintain at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5 % CO₂ and 5 % O₂.

steps.title: Capture phase‑contrast images
steps.instruction: Acquire phase‑contrast images of the cultures using an EVOS™ XL Core Cell Imaging System (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

steps.title: Optional cardiomyocyte purification
steps.instruction: If cardiomyocyte purity is insufficient, perform negative selection using the Human PSC‑Derived Cardiomyocyte Isolation Kit (Miltenyi Biotec, cat no. 130‑110‑188) for up to 5 × 10⁶ cells, keeping most steps on ice.

substeps.instruction: Generate a single‑cell suspension as described in section 2.4 (not detailed here).
Centrifuge the suspension 5 min at 200 g; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 80 µl wash buffer (PBS + 2 % FBS).
Add 20 µl Non‑Cardiomyocyte Depletion Cocktail, mix, and incubate 5 min on ice (4 °C).
Wash cells with 1 ml wash buffer, centrifuge 5 min at 200 g, and discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 80 µl wash buffer.
Add 20 µl Anti‑Biotin MicroBeads, mix, and incubate 10 min on ice (4 °C).
Add 400 µl wash buffer to the suspension.
Place an LS column in the magnetic field of a MACS separator and wash the column with 3 ml wash buffer.
Apply 500 µl of the cell suspension to the column; collect the flow‑through (contains purified CMs).
Wash the column three times with 3 ml wash buffer each, collecting all flow‑through in the same tube.

steps.title: Fix cells with PFA
steps.instruction: Fix cultured cells by adding 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) and incubating for 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Permeabilize cell membranes
steps.instruction: Permeabilize fixed cells with 0.1 % Triton X‑100 diluted in PBS for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with blocking solution consisting of 5 % Goat serum (Life Technologies, cat no. 16210‑064) in PBS for 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Prepare primary antibody dilutions (see Table 1) in PBS containing 0.05 % Tween 20 and 1 % BSA; add to cells and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute secondary antibodies (Table 1) in PBS with 0.05 % Tween 20 and 1 % BSA; incubate cells for 60 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Nuclear staining with Hoechst
steps.instruction: Incubate cells for 10 min with 0.1 % Hoechst solution at room temperature.

steps.title: Mount and image samples
steps.instruction: Mount stained cells on appropriate slides and acquire images using a ZEISS LSM900 confocal microscope.
